translations.web: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
translations.bsb: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
translations.kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
translations.asv: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.
